description: Privilege expansion between two manifests: npm, Chrome extension, Android — Compares an old and a new manifest and reports every way the new one gains privilege, for agents reviewing dependency bumps and extension or app updates. npm package.json: new or changed install-time lifecycle scripts, gypfile, bin entries and URL/git/file dependencies (including overrides). Chrome manifest.json: added permissions with Chrome's own warning text, host access not covered by the old

before.description: Old manifest text (package.json, manifest.json or AndroidManifest.xml).

threshold.description: any (default): every added permission fails. sensitive: ignore Chrome permissions without a warning and Android normal permissions.

name: permission-delta
